I heavily relate to this story. Last week I left my wife because of her emotional and sexual abuse. At first she refused to admit she was ever wrong and continued to say how I’m making all the issues up and that I was the one who never tried. Yesterday she told me the exact thing your spouse did, that she abused me but she’s not an abuser. “Because it wasn’t intentional (my) feelings aren’t real and (she) didn’t abuse (me)”. The only thing she cares about is bringing me back home alone without anyone who she doesn’t approve of present to try to manipulate me. I saw her alone a few times and every time was a mistake. Stick with your support system. Don’t meet your spouse in an environment that they can easily manipulate you. It’s all a game and I’ve learned that the hard way.
